name: thimble
description: A browser workspace beside a Claude Code session for making sense of a corpus of files: chat, files, a canvas of cards and a report. Start it with /thimble in a Claude Code session, or with the `thimble` command, a shortcut that runs Claude Code with this plugin and /thimble: the session is the main thread, the browser mirrors it, and what the analyst asks in the browser reaches the session through the plugin's hooks (hooks/hooks.json). One MCP server (the thimble tools), the /thimble and /thimble:orient skills, and the shared skill, which loads thimble's shared guidance for subagents that are not forks, since those get none of their parent's prompt. The orientation, its critic, a writer, the builder and the reviewer of a view, each run of a report check and the agent of a code ticket are subagents of the session, of the types the plugin's hooks module registers (hooks/thimble.ts).

autoActivate.title: Turn on when Claude reads data
autoActivate.description: Turn thimble on in a session the first time Claude reads a data file in the session's folder. /thimble turns it on either way.

viewProposals.title: View proposals
viewProposals.description: After a turn, thimble may propose a view of the files: a page that shows their records in a form the files hide.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Labels that a model applies to every record of a file, and their lists of records no category fit.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Checks that read Claude's answers and documents and comment on passages, which the terminal highlights.

citationMarks.title: Citation marks
citationMarks.description: A check mark or a red cross on each citation, after thimble checks that the cited place holds the value.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: What Claude read or searched of the data files in this session, under answers and in the panel.

cardCheck.title: Card check
cardCheck.description: After a card is made or changed, a check of its takeaway and its citations against its output.
